name: Group Dentistry Now
audience: DSO/group-practice execs, dentists, students, faculty, industry
est_audience_size: ~150000 sphere of influence (weekly DSO Weekly enewsletter)
contact_method: Contact Bill Neumann / Kim Larson via site form or LinkedIn
free_promotion_angle: Pitch a short editorial "new tool" story on an honest free dental-resource directory + the AI-narration flagging angle
rules_or_gotchas: Editorial/partnership route only (also a LinkedIn company page ~150k) — not an open group
notes: Largest dedicated dental-industry newsletter; actively features tools/products; single warm contact; best reach-per-effort in this lane

name: MedMark Media (Endo/Implant/Ortho/Sleep Practice US)
audience: Endodontists, implant, orthodontic, sleep dentists (print + web)
contact_method: Submit via article-submissions page / editorial email
free_promotion_angle: FREE product press-release placement in all journals + websites — submit a launch blurb
notes: Explicitly free placement across specialty outlets incl. endodontics (founder's specialty). Low effort.

name: AGD Impact (Academy of General Dentistry)
free_promotion_angle: AGD Impact welcomes news tips/stories — pitch a short mention of a free GP resource directory
notes: Exact GP audience + an editorial email that solicits news tips. Low-effort, high-fit.

name: Oral Health Group (Canada)
contact_method: Submissions portal (Word doc) then freelance agreement
free_promotion_angle: FREE contributed articles/blogs — write a piece featuring curated resources; you keep rights
rules_or_gotchas: Open submissions portal; core Canadian market
notes: Primary Canadian-market editorial channel with a free contributed-content path.

name: Dentistry Today
free_promotion_angle: Byline/trends article or product news pitch (curated-ranking + AI-voice-disclosure concept)
rules_or_gotchas: Submissions page returned 403 to bot — confirm contact specifics (UNVERIFIED); leans clinical
notes: Real outlet + submissions page; good for a trends/opinion piece rather than a plug.

name: DentistryIQ (Endeavor)
contact_method: Press releases + article pitches per submission guidelines
free_promotion_angle: Free press-release review + contributed byline articles
notes: Established free press-release + contributed-article path.

name: Canadian Dental Association / JCDA
audience: All Canadian dentists (JCDA journal + CDA Oasis community)
contact_method: CDA Contact Us / JCDA editorial; CDA Oasis
free_promotion_angle: Free exposure realistic via CDA Oasis community or a JCDA-adjacent note
notes: National reach but institutional; Oasis/community is the realistic free surface.

name: California Dental Association (CDA)
free_promotion_angle: Local component-society newsletters are the easier free wins; Journal of CDA harder
notes: Largest US state assoc. Go via local component newsletters.

name: Texas Dental Association (TDA)
audience: Texas dentists (TDA Today + Texas Dental Journal)
free_promotion_angle: Member-news mention via TDA Today or component society newsletters
notes: Best via component/local newsletters.

name: American Association of Endodontists (AAE)
audience: Endodontists & residents (clinical resources hub + Endo Voices podcast)
contact_method: AAE membership/comms; member community; APICES resident event
free_promotion_angle: Inclusion in member resource links or a mention via AAE community / Endo Voices; resident onboarding
notes: Strong founder-fit (endodontist). Free exposure likely via member community.

name: dentistrynewsletters.com
free_promotion_angle: FREE directory inclusion if TDC launches a subscribable newsletter
rules_or_gotchas: Requires TDC to have an email newsletter
notes: Fast free listing/backlink once a newsletter exists.

name: The Very Dental Podcast Network
free_promotion_angle: Cross-promo, guest spot, "we ranked your network" feature, ad swap
notes: Multi-show reach + easy warm angle since we list them. Top pick.

name: Dental Digest Podcast (Dr. Melissa Seibert)
free_promotion_angle: Guest appearance, cross-promo, feature as top-ranked clinical pod
rules_or_gotchas: Interview format = built to take guests
notes: Award-winning, ideal pro audience.

name: Shared Practices Podcast
audience: New dentists & students on practice-ownership path
free_promotion_angle: Guest spot, cross-promo to student/new-grad audience
notes: Audience = our exact core (students/new grads).

name: The Dental Student Podcast (Onni Franco)
audience: Pre-dental, dental students, residents, new grads
free_promotion_angle: Guest, cross-promo, co-feature; recommended-resource mention in an episode
notes: Perfect audience match; likely eager to cross-promote. Warm testimonial source.

name: Bulletproof Dental Practice
free_promotion_angle: Explicit guest intake (MyStory series), cross-promo, feature
notes: Lowest-friction ask — a published guest hotline + email.

name: The Dentalpreneur Podcast (Dr. Mark Costes)
free_promotion_angle: Guest, cross-promo, feature as top-ranked PM pod
rules_or_gotchas: Very established host; warmer via ""we ranked you"""
notes: Big reach; lead with the listing angle.

name: Dental A Team Podcast (Kiera Dent)
free_promotion_angle: Guest, cross-promo, feature
notes: High-frequency show receptive to guests.

name: The Dental Download (Dr. Haley Schultz)
free_promotion_angle: Guest, cross-promo to student/new-grad niche
notes: Interviews specialists/residents; strong student fit.

name: The Thriving Dentist Show (Gary Takacs)
free_promotion_angle: Guest, cross-promo, feature
notes: Large but coaching-oriented; partnership plausible via listing angle.

name: Mental Dental (YouTube)
free_promotion_angle: Reciprocal mention/collab: list them; ask for a description/community-tab link
notes: Trusted free board-prep brand with captive student audience.

name: Dr. Teeth Academy (Dr. Hine Malik)
free_promotion_angle: Collab video, feature, cross-promo to student base
notes: Student-education fit.

name: Hack Dentistry (YouTube)
free_promotion_angle: Collab, feature, cross-promo
notes: Exam-prep audience = students.

name: Teeth Talk Girl (Whitney DiFoggio RDH)
free_promotion_angle: Reciprocal listing + description/community-tab mention
notes: Secondary fit; accessible.

name: Dental Digest (YouTube
free_promotion_angle: YouTube About / business email
column14: Massive reach if landed; hard to reach. Long-shot mention.

name: Dental Nachos
audience: Dentists, students, team members, sales (Dr. Paul Goodman)
contact_method: Message admins/founder Paul Goodman via group or dentalnachos.com
free_promotion_angle: Value-first helpful answers; found­er buy-in for a "value" post or podcast collab
rules_or_gotchas: Overt promo/link-drops removed unless admin-approved; pro-vendor-friendly but curated
notes: Large, engaged, resource-sharing culture; founder reachable. Value-first only.

name: Dentaltown Message Boards
audience: Dentists, specialists, assistants, techs, front desk (largest dental forum)
contact_method: Register free; Dentaltown/Farran Media for partnerships
free_promotion_angle: Answer on-topic threads (podcasts/software/CE boards) and cite the directory as a resource; evergreen SEO
rules_or_gotchas: Terms bar solicitation/advertising — must be genuinely on-topic
notes: Biggest dental-pro forum; category structure matches our verticals. Contribute as a peer.

name: Nifty Thrifty Dentists
contact_method: Ask to join; admins via niftythriftydentists.com (Dr. Vinh Nguyen)
free_promotion_angle: Answer questions and cite the free directory; vendors usually need approval
notes: Deals-savvy, resource-hungry audience. Lead with value.

name: r/Dentistry
free_promotion_angle: Comment helpfully; share only in direct answer to "good podcast/resource?" threads; ask mods first
rules_or_gotchas: Self-promo/advertising effectively banned; low-karma link posts auto-removed; blatant promo = ban
notes: Perfect audience but strict. Value-first; get mod permission.

name: r/DentalSchool
free_promotion_angle: Answer "best study resource/podcast/book" questions; occasional resource post if mods allow
notes: Students actively seek curated learning resources; frame as free study aid.

name: Student Doctor Network (Dental/Pre-Dental)
free_promotion_angle: Answer application/study/resource threads and cite the directory; evergreen indexed SEO
notes: High-intent — people literally ask for resources. Respect anti-spam norms.

name: r/DentalHygiene
free_promotion_angle: Share hygiene-relevant resources when asked
notes: Adjacent audience; relevant for hygiene CE/podcast picks.

name: Dental Practice Matchmaker
free_promotion_angle: Value-first answers
rules_or_gotchas: Intensely moderated; unapproved promo removed; narrow topic
notes: Engaged but topically narrow. Verify exact group URL.

name: Dental Peeps
free_promotion_angle: Share resources in context; possible listing on their network site
notes: Established brand/network; confirm size/rules.

name: Instagram dental community (#dentalstudent #dentistry #dentalce)
contact_method: No central mod — DM creators/influencers for collabs
free_promotion_angle: Run own IG; post curated "best of" lists; collab with dental influencers
rules_or_gotchas: IG limits link reach; comment spam hurts reputation
notes: No gatekeeper but needs sustained content. Owned-channel + influencer play.

name: FeedSpot (dental podcast/blog/YouTube lists)
free_promotion_angle: Free basic inclusion across sibling lists (podcasts, blogs, dentist YouTubers) = several links from one workflow
rules_or_gotchas: Upsells paid ""featured"" placement; organic listing still free
notes: Very high DA, self-serve, multiple lists. 403 to bot but page is real/live.

name: Dental-school library LibGuides (UNC/Michigan/Penn/UIC/USC/Harvard...)
contact_method: Email each guide's subject/dental librarian (Ask a Librarian)
free_promotion_angle: Ask the librarian to add TDC to the "web resources/podcasts" section — evergreen authoritative backlink
rules_or_gotchas: Repeatable across dozens of schools; one email each
notes: .edu authority; librarians routinely add legitimate free student resources. High-value + repeatable.

name: Today's RDH (Write for Us)
free_promotion_angle: Contribute a genuine article (e.g., "How to vet a dental podcast for AI narration") with author-bio link
rules_or_gotchas: Real editorial pipeline (not a link farm); repeatable
notes: Contextual dofollow author-bio link; high relevance to student/hygienist audience.

name: ASDA (Write for ASDA / Mouth / Contour)
contact_method: Author submission form (must be ASDA member)
free_promotion_angle: Member-authored article that curates student resources; authoritative .org + bullseye audience
notes: Authoritative .org, exact audience, editorial not spammy.

name: Source of Sources / Qwoted (HARO successors)
contact_method: Free expert account; respond by email
free_promotion_angle: Answer dentistry / "AI in healthcare media" queries as a named expert → earned press links
notes: Ongoing free source of contextual media links. Source of Sources is a free email digest.

name: NexHealth — 20 Best Dental Podcasts
free_promotion_angle: Pitch to add TDC as the curated "ranked directory" companion; AI-voice hook

name: Weave — 27 Dental Podcasts...
free_promotion_angle: Ask to be added as the "where to find/rank all of these" resource
rules_or_gotchas: 403 to bot but live via search; strong DA
notes: Content-collab angle.

name: Goodpods — Top Dentistry leaderboard
free_promotion_angle: Build a curator profile/playlist of shows we rank, linking back
rules_or_gotchas: Better as brand/curation presence than strong dofollow link
notes: Curation presence play.

name: MillionPodcasts (Dental rankings)
free_promotion_angle: Request inclusion / "ranked-by" mention; sibling student/hygiene/school lists
notes: Secondary directory play.

name: RDH Magazine (Submissions)
free_promotion_angle: Contributed article with author-bio link
rules_or_gotchas: Higher bar (original research favored); slower; some pieces paid
notes: Authoritative but slower editorial cycle.

name: DrBicuspid
free_promotion_angle: Pitch as a news story ("new site ranks dental media, flags AI-narrated shows")
rules_or_gotchas: No public self-serve contributor form (UNVERIFIED); newsroom pitch only
notes: Best as a news pitch, ideally around the AI-voice audit.

name: Wikidata (WikiProject Podcasts)
free_promotion_angle: Add/curate structured items for shows we index with official-website statements
rules_or_gotchas: No traditional backlink juice; notability rules (our own item UNVERIFIED)
notes: Feeds knowledge panels/AI answers; slow payoff.

name: Guest-post dental blogs (Tooth Remedy / DentalsReview)
contact_method: "Write for Us" form on each site
free_promotion_angle: Original 800-1500 word article with resource link; some accept student authors
rules_or_gotchas: Lower authority; some skirt link-farm territory — vet quality
notes: Easy/fast but low-value. Opportunistic only. DentalsReview: dentalsreview.com/write-for-us-guest-post/

name: ASDA — American Student Dental Association
audience: US dental students (~92% at 66 schools) + predental
free_promotion_angle: Free listing on "Dental Student Resources" page; chapter newsletter/GroupMe/Slack shares; guest blog on Mouth/Contour
rules_or_gotchas: Editorial/chapter partnership — not a link-drop forum
notes: Highest-value US student node. Multiple free surfaces map perfectly to a free directory.

name: ASDA National Instagram (@dentalstudents)
contact_method: IG DM / tag in a useful post
free_promotion_angle: Featured via a genuinely useful "study resource" reel; supply a shareable directory graphic for a repost
notes: Single account reaching 33k target students at zero cost. High virality potential.

name: FCDSA (Federation of Canadian Dentistry Student Assocs)
free_promotion_angle: Mention in monthly webinar series/newsletter; pitch the 10 member associations; Canada-relevant resource list
notes: Best Canadian student play — covers the entire Canadian student market in one relationship.

name: Student National Dental Association (SNDA)
audience: Dental students (minority-focused), chapters at most US schools
contact_method: Contact form + chapters page; national board
free_promotion_angle: Offer directory for resource/scholarship pages + convention materials; engage local chapters
notes: Broad engaged national org with its own convention.

name: ADEA GoDental
free_promotion_angle: Pitch directory as a free "explore dentistry" resource on resource pages/virtual fair; reach advisors
notes: Top-of-funnel (aspiring students) + advisors at scale, all free.

name: AGD Student Chapters
audience: Dental students in AGD chapters + AEGD/GPR-track
free_promotion_angle: Inclusion in AGD Impact student content / student-chapter resource emails
notes: Solid education org with school-level chapters; requires org buy-in.

name: AAO — Students & Residents
free_promotion_angle: Mention in resident onboarding / CE Passport resource lists
rules_or_gotchas: Institutional but on-brand for specialty pillar
notes: Existing free-resource habit (CE Passport). Specialty-pillar fit.

name: ASDA District/Chapter Instagram accounts (e.g. @asdadistrict3)
free_promotion_angle: Provide a shareable resource graphic for reposts — repeat across all districts/chapters
notes: Scalable low-effort repost tactic across many accounts.
